dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, forming a smooth fusiform shape.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely smooth lateral margins with a slight localized indentation on the left-hand side approximately two-thirds down the visible length.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity consistent with a near-mature or mature individual, despite chromatic shifts from water turbidity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse clusters of slightly darker grey pixels distributed sporadically across the dorsal surface, most notably on the left side.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and soft-edged transitions between the primary light-toned canvas and localized darker-grey mottling.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of faint, vertical linear markings along the central dorsal plane and several low-contrast light spots (potential water droplets or superficial markings).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Faint, parallel linear marks consistent with superficial rake marks are visible along the mid-to-right dorsal axis.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-contrast, white filamentous feature is visible at the anterior extremity, potentially representing a surface water break or floating debris.
